summary.text: Brett Mauldin is the Republican candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 114 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Michael Caw; the seat has no incumbent.
He is president and co-owner of MarbleWorks and a former youth pastor.

paragraphs.text: Mauldin was born in Marietta, Georgia, and earned a bachelor's degree from Lee University in 2004, according to Ballotpedia, which says he has been affiliated with the Lake Oconee builder association and the Home Building Association of Georgia.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father and second-generation businessman, and said he began working in his family's granite and marble business with his father.
Mauldin ran for Georgia State Senate District 17 in 2022 and lost the Republican primary to incumbent Brian Strickland, 73.2 percent to 26.8 percent.
In 2026, he defeated Wendell McNeal in the Republican primary for House District 114 on May 19.
His 2022 survey listed election security and integrity, support for small businesses, and transparency in government among his priorities.
